gloss: reliance; dependence; someone to rely on

definitions.gloss: reliance; dependence; someone or something to count on
definitions.explanation: A person, thing, or quality that one depends on for help or support. Often used to describe someone who is dependable.

examples.english: He's the only one I can count on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頼|たよ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I searched for the way relying on my memory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頼|たよ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: With no map, I kept walking relying only on the starlight.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ (to rely on). Refers to what one depends on for support or guidance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頼|たよ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rely on X, to use X as a guide
- X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頼|たよ}りだ: X is what one counts on
- {頼|たよ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be dependable/reliable
- {頼|たよ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be unreliable
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頼|たよ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: doing something relying on X

CONFUSION NOTE:
Do not confuse with ⟦{便|たよ}り→便り：03411_tayori⟧ (news, letter, communication from someone). They are written with different kanji but share the same reading たより.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当|あ}て: something to rely on/count on (often in ⟦{当|あ}てにする→当てにする：25856_atenisuru⟧)
- ⟦{支|ささ}え→支え：13038_sasae⟧: support (emotional or physical)
